thread.topic: [TUTORIAL] How to bind a key in order to buy an item on the TTT shop

posts.subject: [TUTORIAL] How to bind a key in order to buy an item on the TTT shop
posts.bodyHtml:
Hello Dream Community,


I will explain something I found and it could be interesting for the people like me who didn't know how to bind a key to buy a taser for exemple.



I Lists of items names


This list can be print in your console by typing


sm_showitems


ShortName LongName Team hlthstat Health Station CT hurtstat Hurt Station T dt Decoy Teleporter T hs_t Healthshot T hs_d Healthshot CT c4 C4 T jihad Jihad Bomb T fb Fakebody T taser_d Taser CT kevlarT Kevlar for T T kevlarD Kevlar for DETECTIVE CT heavyT Heavy suit for T T heavyD Heavy suit for DETECTIVE CT helmT Helm for T T helmD Helm for DETECTIVE CT khelmT Kevlar+Helm for T T kelmD Kevlar+Helm for DETECTIVE CT 1knife 1-Hit Knife T m4a1s M4A1-S T awp AWP T usps USP-S T tag TA-GRENADE T dna Dnascanner CT id_t Fake ID for T T id Id for Innocent T/CT icek Ice - Knife T hs Healthshot for Innocent CT/T



II Bind a key to buy an item


Well, you need to type this command in your console :


bind <your key here> "sm_buyitem <name of your item here>"


Exemple : bind j "sm_buyitem 1knife" -> This bind will buy for you a 1 hit knife.


You can replace j and 1knife by the key and the item you want 😄



III Conclusion


I hope this tutorial will be useful for some people and do not hesitate to reply if you saw any mistakes or if you want to add something to this.
